long_biography.plain_text:
Altran co-founder Hubert Martigny financed the architectural and acoustic renovation of Paris’s Salle Pleyel after acquiring the concert hall. His company carried out the work before the venue was leased to the Cité de la musique. The public institution subsequently bought the hall in 2009.

Martigny also acquired the separate Pleyel piano manufacturer, where he encouraged collaborations with contemporary designers. Pleyel and Peugeot Design Lab produced a grand piano in 2012 during his presidency. He insisted that changes to the instrument should preserve its characteristic sound and touch. The designers lowered the mechanism to keyboard level, allowing audiences to see the pianist’s hands more clearly.
long_biography.html:
Altran co-founder Hubert Martigny financed the architectural and acoustic renovation of Paris’s Salle Pleyel after acquiring the concert hall. His company carried out the work before the venue was leased to the Cité de la musique. The public institution subsequently bought the hall in 2009.

Martigny also acquired the separate Pleyel piano manufacturer, where he encouraged collaborations with contemporary designers. Pleyel and Peugeot Design Lab produced a grand piano in 2012 during his presidency. He insisted that changes to the instrument should preserve its characteristic sound and touch. The designers lowered the mechanism to keyboard level, allowing audiences to see the pianist’s hands more clearly.
